elements.label: 2. bcrypt.compare(typed, stored hash)
elements.sub: the stored value is a hash — it cannot be turned back into the password

elements.label: 3. jwt.sign({ userId, email }, SECRET, { expiresIn: '1h' })
elements.sub: signed, not encrypted — anyone can read it, nobody can forge it

elements.label: 5. jwt.verify(token, SECRET)  →  req.userData
elements.sub: the server stores nothing — the token carries who you are

elements.text: authentication = who you are   ·   authorisation = what you may touch
